package nats

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"sync"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// Publisher publishes durable course/task lifecycle events to JetStream.
type Publisher struct {
	Conn *natsgo.Conn

	mu sync.Mutex
	js natsgo.JetStreamContext
}

// Publish sends immediately outside a transaction and defers delivery while
// an outer import transaction is still open.
func (p *Publisher) Publish(ctx context.Context, subject string, payload any) error {
	if repository.DeferAfterCommit(ctx, func() { _ = p.publishNow(subject, payload) }) {
		return nil
	}
	return p.publishNow(subject, payload)
}

func (p *Publisher) publishNow(subject string, payload any) error {
	if p.Conn == nil {
		return nil
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	js, err := p.jetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = js.Publish(subject, body)
	return err
}

var _ domain.EventPublisher = (*Publisher)(nil)

func (p *Publisher) jetStream() (natsgo.JetStreamContext, error) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	if p.js != nil {
		return p.js, nil
	}
	js, err := p.Conn.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	p.js = js
	return p.js, nil
}
